newsitem.title: FRANCE: France sets 38 Fr/shr on Bull stake sale.
newsitem.headline: France sets 38 Fr/shr on Bull stake sale.

text.p: The French finance ministry said on Tuesday it was launching from Wednesday the sale of a further 16.2 million shares in computer maker Cie des Machines Bull, with 14.58 million shares going to institutional investors at 38 francs per share.

There is a 10 percent clawback on the institutional tranche in favour of retail investors. The sale to institutions will be done through a book-building exercise and can be closed at any time from Wednesday.
The government has given banks handling the institutional sale an option to buy a further 900,000 shares.

Of the total sale, 1.62 million shares will be sold to private investors at a price of 36 francs per share, with the stock being offered from Wednesday morning and ending on April 28 in the evening, the ministry said in a statement.
Retail investors can also pay for the shares with the six percent 1997 bonds for which the value is set at 105.43 francs, with coupon attached.

Some 1.8 million shares have been set aside for Bull employees and former staff, with a possible further 100,000 shares available if the selling banks in the institutional tranche exercise their option to buy more stock.
The government currently holds 30.5 percent in Bull's capital. The pre-placement for institutions began on April 14.
